label: King of the Franks
notes: Rex Francorum; held by Carolingians 751–843, continuing in West Francia until 987.

label: Emperor of the Romans (Carolingian)
notes: Imperator Romanorum; Charlemagne crowned 800, Carolingian emperors until 888, intermittent after.

label: King of West Francia
notes: Ruler of the western Frankish kingdom after the Treaty of Verdun (843).

label: King of East Francia
notes: Ruler of the eastern Frankish kingdom after 843; precursor of the Holy Roman Empire.

label: King of Middle Francia
notes: Created by Treaty of Verdun (843); short-lived central kingdom under Lothair I.

label: King of Italy (Carolingian)
notes: Carolingian kings of the Lombards/Italy; held often by emperors.
